environment: Local production Next.js server, Chromium, API and model fixtures; no production writes

checks.note: Includes production compilation and TypeScript validation. Existing Google Fonts downloaded during build.

checks.command: npx eslint app lib src proxy.ts scripts/check_i18n.mjs scripts/check_seo.mjs

checks.note: Isolated local test admin credential; inbox and submissions mocked.

review: Site and grading language selectors sit below Billing and refunds in the sidebar account dialog, save on selection, and roll back on failure. No save button or explanatory copy.
Settings stay within 375px Korean and Malay mobile viewports; visible labels, focus indicators, error messages and Escape dismissal.

Project selector beside Assignment on the left and result language on the right share the top result row. Controls wrap on mobile without horizontal overflow; the temporary-translation explanation is removed.
Switching workspace language preserves the current draft and original evaluation.

Explicit /ko and /ms home and guide URLs override saved account or browser site language. Query strings and fragments survive account preference loading. The neutral root still restores the account default; grading language changes do not overwrite that default.
Temporary translation preserves scores, rubric names, evidence, account preferences, access restrictions and the saved original.
Server-rendered public copy, unique localized metadata, canonical URLs, reciprocal hreflang, internal links, structured data and sitemap verified. Unknown localized paths return 404.
limitations: OpenAI translation and grading calls were mocked. No live model-language quality claim is made.
Redis behavior was exercised through API/module fixtures; existing production credentials and actual cross-device persistence were not used.
Repository-wide npm run lint has six pre-existing no-require-imports errors in doc/growth/*.cjs; application-source lint has no errors.
No deployment or production data migration was performed. No new environment variable or migration is required.
